scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: npx prisma generate && pnpm --filter @workspace/scholar-guide run build
scripts.build:vercel: npx prisma generate && pnpm --filter @workspace/scholar-guide exec vite build --config vite.vercel.config.ts
